purpose: First-class candidate route packet for turning the current Noir ACIR artifact into Solana Groth16 proof-format, verifying-key, and verifier-adapter artifacts for C01 tag 3. This packet identifies the route and blockers only; it does not accept the route for production.

productionGroth16ToolchainPreflightRef.truthBoundary: The preflight records that local bb can produce UltraHonk artifacts but not the required Groth16 production artifact lane.

sunspotCompatibility.truthBoundary: The Sunspot route cannot produce reviewed production Groth16 proof/VK artifacts from this local toolchain until the required Noir/Nargo version, Sunspot binary, GNARK verifier binary, reviewed setup, artifact pinning, and reviewer acceptance are present.

unsafeDefaultSetupBoundary.truthBoundary: A default single-operator Groth16 setup is not production verifying-key evidence for Vanta. Production acceptance requires a reviewed ceremony or equivalent toxic-waste mitigation for the exact actual-private-spend circuit.

localDevProbeSummary.truthBoundary: A temporary beta18 source shim could traverse Sunspot compile/setup/prove/verify, build a local verifier SBF artifact, and pass the generated standalone Solana verifier in local LiteSVM with the selected Gnark-native 324-byte proof plus 44-byte public witness. The setup was unsafe, the current spend-program tag-3 ABI now reserves that selected tuple fail-closed and rejects the legacy 256-byte proof-only shape, Sunspot compile output reported zero public/secret inputs while the generated verifier records one public input, and no production proof/VK/spend-program adapter/live/audit evidence is accepted.

truthBoundary: This is a fail-closed candidate route packet for C01's selected Groth16 tag-3 backend. It proves only that the ACIR-to-Solana-Groth16 route has been selected for artifact investigation and that local prerequisites and production setup acceptance are still missing. It is not production proof-format evidence, not production verifying-key evidence, not verifier-adapter acceptance, not tag-3 proof acceptance, not on-chain proof verification, not SBF/live redeploy or reinit evidence, not audit acceptance, not production-private readiness, and not real-funds readiness.
